# The DRIPBaR New Braunfels

> The DRIPBaR New Braunfels is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in New Braunfels, Texas. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, wellness therapies, and functional health testing (VO2 Max, DNA genetic testing, and lab testing), delivered by licensed medical professionals under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 312 FM 306, Suite 112, New Braunfels, TX 78130
- Phone: call (830) 730-5304; text (830) 971-0044
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 9 AM to 3 PM; Sunday: 10 AM to 3 PM
- Booking: https://newbraunfels.dripbarsanantonio.com/booking (online, 24/7) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $199. The Debut is $139 and 100% Hydration is $99. Ask about member pricing. Specialty drips such as NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, and Alpha Lipoic Acid are priced by dose.
- New guest offer: New guests choose their experience and receive up to $100 in free perks on the first visit: a Lifestyle drip, a booster add-on, and one supportive therapy.
- Functional health: VO2 Max testing with PNOE breath analysis (about 30 minutes, book online), DNA genetic testing (four panels, book a consultation online; details at https://newbraunfels.dripbarsanantonio.com/genetic-testing), and lab testing (call or text (830) 971-0044 to schedule). Results are reviewed with the clinical team.
- All services are administered under the supervision of Dr. A.D. Thakkar, M.D. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, and NAD+ planning.
